definition: Index n+1 denotes an earlier deadline than index n. At its deadline Reaper n acts if and only if no Reaper with an earlier deadline acts. This is a static logical test of the stipulated condition, without claims about actual time, prior deaths, or causal powers.
note: Defines a clean unsatisfiable-pair thought experiment, not an interpretation of every Benardete, Koons or Pruss variant. Historical sourcing and modal transfer require independent witnesses and arguments.
